# WoodWorks

> > Technical resource and education hub for wood and mass timber construction, providing design guidance, code compliance support, and engineering resources for architects and structural engineers.

WoodWorks, an initiative of the Wood Products Council, offers comprehensive technical documentation on mass timber (CLT, glulam, NLT), light-frame wood construction, building code compliance (IBC), and structural engineering topics including seismic design, fire resistance, and podium construction. The organization provides webinars, case studies, design examples, and project support to advance wood construction in commercial and institutional buildings.

## Key Topics

- Mass Timber (CLT, NLT, Glulam)
- Light-Frame Wood Construction
- Building Code Compliance (IBC)
- Seismic Design
- Fire Resistance Ratings
- Podium Construction
- Structural Engineering
- Prefabrication & Panelization
- Wood Design Case Studies
- WBLCA (Whole Building Life Cycle Assessment)
- High-Performance Envelopes
- Shear Wall Design
- Off-Site/Modular Construction
- Appearance Specifications
- Wind Design

## Mass Timber Design & Construction

- [Fire Design of Mass Timber Structural Members: Demonstrating Fire-Resistance Ratings of Mass Timber Products](https://www.woodworks.org/resources/fire-design-of-mass-timber-structural-members): Fire-resistance rating testing and analytical methods for mass timber
- [Specifying Appearance for CLT, NLT and Glulam](https://www.woodworks.org/resources/specifying-appearance-grades-for-clt-nlt-and-glulam): Appearance specification guide for CLT, NLT, and glulam mass timber
- [Construction Quality Assurance on Mass Timber Projects: Inspection and Observation](https://www.woodworks.org/resources/mass-timber-projects-inspection-and-observation): Mass timber inspection and observation planning per 2021 IBC
- [Exterior Walls in Mass Timber Buildings – Part 4: Panelization](https://www.woodworks.org/resources/exterior-walls-in-mass-timber-buildings-part-4-panelization): Mass timber exterior wall panelization benefits and methods guide
- [Innovations in Heavy Timber Construction](https://www.woodworks.org/resources/innovations-in-heavy-timber-construction): Heavy timber case studies including Cathedral of Christ the Light
- [Advancing Mass Timber Construction 2024](https://www.woodworks.org/complex-events/q3-24-advancing-mass-timber-in-person): Nashville 2024 mass timber conference on codes and project delivery
- [The Future of Mass Timber Development in DC](https://www.woodworks.org/event/q4-25-future-mass-timber-dc-in-person-odonald): DC mass timber development seminar with Sycamore & Oak case studies
- [Oxbow Site Tour: A Firsthand Look at Mass Timber Construction](https://www.woodworks.org/event/q2-25-oxbow-tour-scarlett-in-person): Charlotte NC site tour of 7-story mass timber mixed-use Oxbow project

## Building Code & Compliance

- [Code Path and Requirements for Mid-Rise Podium Projects](https://www.woodworks.org/resources/code-path-and-requirements-for-podium-projects): IBC Section 510.2 code requirements for mid-rise podium construction
- [Regulating Off-Site Construction: Ensuring Code Compliance in a Factory-Built Environment](https://www.woodworks.org/resources/regulating-off-site-construction-ensuring-code-compliance-in-a-factory-built-environment): Building code compliance guide for modular/factory-built construction

## Structural Engineering & Design Examples

- [Seismic Design of Timber Panelized Roof Structures](https://www.woodworks.org/resources/seismic-design-of-timber-panelized-roof-structures): Design example for seismic timber roof diaphragms in N. California
- [Wind Design of Timber Panelized Roof Structures](https://www.woodworks.org/resources/wind-design-of-timber-panelized-roof-structures): Wind design example for timber panelized roofs on tilt-up buildings
- [Designing Light-Frame Wood Structures Over Podiums: Seismic Considerations](https://www.woodworks.org/complex-events/q4-25-light-frame-over-podiums-seismic-considerations-national): Webinar on seismic design for light-frame over concrete podiums per ASCE 7-22
- [Practical Considerations for Shear Wall Connections and Details](https://www.woodworks.org/complex-events/practical-considerations-shear-wall-connections): Webinar on light-frame shear wall connection design and details

## Commercial & Institutional Case Studies

- [Student Housing Uses Wood Framing To Meet Ambitious Design Goals](https://www.woodworks.org/resources/student-housing-uses-wood-framing-to-meet-ambitious-design-goals): U of Washington student housing case study using wood-frame construction
- [Why Consider a Panelized Wood Roof Systems for Commercial Buildings](https://www.woodworks.org/resources/why-consider-a-panelized-wood-roof-systems-for-commercial-buildings): Panelized wood roof benefits for commercial buildings with case studies

## Sustainability & Performance

- [WBLCA Worksheet](https://www.woodworks.org/resources/wblca-worksheet): Fillable PDF worksheet for whole building life cycle assessment (WBLCA)
- [High-Performance Envelopes in Wood Construction](https://www.woodworks.org/complex-events/q2-25-high-performance-envelopes-national): Webinar on energy-efficient envelopes and Passive House in wood buildings

## News & Updates

- [WoodWorks Announces 2022 Partners](https://www.woodworks.org/woodworks-announces-2022-partners): 2022 industry partner announcement covering wood products sector
- [WoodWorks at the Mass Timber Conference](https://www.woodworks.org/woodworks-at-the-conference): 2023 Mass Timber Conference updates and Wood Design Awards coverage
